originalTitle: Big Bull's magic: How Rakesh Jhunjhunwala turned Rs 1 crore into Rs 20 crore overnight after the 1989 budget
simplifiedContent: Here's a simplified version of the news item: Rakesh Jhunjhunwala, a famous investor, made a lot of money in 1989 by going against what most people thought would happen. Many investors were scared of the government's new budget and were selling their stocks, but Jhunjhunwala thought the government would actually help businesses grow. He invested Rs 1 crore and it quickly turned into Rs 20 crore, which is a huge profit. This matters because it shows that Jhunjhunwala was a smart and confident investor who wasn't afraid to disagree with the majority. This investment decision helped build his reputation as a skilled investor, known as the "Big Bull" of the stock market.

originalTitle: Mcap of five of top-10 most valued firms erodes by Rs 1 lakh cr; TCS takes biggest hit
simplifiedContent: Last week, the value of five of India's top 10 most valuable companies decreased by a huge amount - Rs 1 lakh crore. The company that lost the most value was Tata Consultancy Services. However, some other companies actually gained value during the same time. Despite this ups and downs, Reliance Industries remained the most valuable Indian company. This matters because it shows that the stock market can be unpredictable and volatile, with some companies losing value while others gain.

originalTitle: 9 Sensex stocks with up to 41% upside potential. Are these in your portfolio?
simplifiedContent: Some big companies in the Indian stock market, known as Sensex stocks, are expected to do well over the next year. In fact, 9 of these companies could see their stock prices go up by 20-41% in the next 12 months, according to what analysts think. HDFC Bank, Axis Bank, Reliance Industries, and NTPC are some of the companies that could see big gains. This matters because if you own these stocks, you could potentially make a lot of money. It might be worth considering adding these stocks to your investment portfolio if you haven't already.

originalTitle: Upcoming IPOs: Lalithaa Jewellery Mart IPO, Horizon Industrial Parks IPO among 8 new issues to open next week
simplifiedContent: Next week, several companies will start selling shares to the public for the first time, which is called an Initial Public Offering (IPO). This includes companies like Lalithaa Jewellery Mart, Horizon Industrial Parks, and Sunshine Pictures. These six companies, along with two others, plan to raise a total of over ₹5,499 crore by selling their shares. This is a way for these companies to get money to grow their businesses. It's an opportunity for individual investors like you to buy shares in these companies, but it's essential to do your research before investing.

originalTitle: Small-cap stock under  ₹50 to be in focus on Monday after receipt of NHAI project
simplifiedContent: A small company called Hazoor Multi Projects, whose stock price is currently under ₹50, might be interesting to watch on Monday. This is because the company recently got a project from NHAI, which could be good news for the company. On Friday, the company's stock price actually went down by 3.29% to ₹20.85 per share. This news might matter because it could affect the company's stock price and influence investment decisions on Monday.
